licence_note: Pool outlines are detected water pixels on public-domain NAIP (no synthesized shapes). No parcel or assessor data is used (Maricopa County / Scottsdale parcel licences are not open for commercial use): a pool's owner is the nearest Overture building, a proximity test, not a lot line. Building rings: Overture Maps (ODbL - attribute and share-alike for the building geometry). City boundary: Census TIGER (public domain). States describe the NAIP capture day only, not how a pool is maintained.
owner_method: nearest building (no open parcel lines): the Overture building nearest the pool (outbuildings < 100 m2 count for their nearest main building); confidence medium when the next different owner is >= 4 m farther, else low
